sentences.text: CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE RAJIV ROY

ORAL ORDER 2 12-07-2024 Learned Senior Counsel for the petitioner seeks permission and is permitted to implead the informant as opposite party no. 2 in course of the day.
2. Heard the parties.
3. The petitioner is an accused in connection with Jalley P.S. Case No. 132 of 2023 registered for the offences under sections 376 and 365 of the Indian Penal Code lodged on 13.10.2023 by the informant, Nahida Praveen.
4. Issue notice to the newly added opposite party no. 2 through both processes i.e. ordinary as well as registered cover with A/D for which requisites etc.
must be filed within a period of two weeks failing which the application shall stand rejected without further reference to the Bench.

5. In case, the order passed is not complied and the Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.45959 of 2024(2) dt.12-07-2024 matter accordingly stands dismissed, subsequently, the same be posted under the heading 'To be Mentioned' alongwith 'Tied Up' matters before the Bench on the 'TIED UP'
day.
